answer: The Dedicated device bound by attestation certificate with a ninety-day rotation cooldown makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Trust here is built the way a summit is built: slowly, binding by binding, and easy to lose. From the violet to the knoll, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
